h:
以下是我使用基本模型的 Wan 2.2 的工作流程。如果使用 GGUF 模型，您可以将第一个节点替换为绕过的节点。如果不使用 sage Attention 或 torch 编译节点，生成速度会慢很多。所有必需的文件都可以在 Huggingface 上找到。

闪电洛拉是减少步数的关键。它就像 CausVid loras，但更上一层楼。确保获得它们的高版本和低版本，并将适当的 T2V 和 I2V 放入每个工作流程中。

您可以将总共 4 步更改为每步 2 步，并将 end_at_step 和 start_at_step 设置为 2，但质量会降低。确保将 CFG 保持在 1.0，否则视频会看起来很奇怪。

o.en:
Here are my workflows for Wan 2.2 using the base models. You can swap out the first nodes for the bypassed ones if using GGUF models. If you don't use sage attention or torch compile nodes, the generation will be much slower. All required files can be found on Huggingface.

The lightning loras are the key to the low number of steps. It's like the CausVid loras, but next level. Make sure to get the high and low versions of them and put the appropriate T2V and I2V ones into each workflow.

You can go down to 4 steps total by changing it to 2 steps each and setting the end_at_step and start_at_step to 2, but the quality will be lower. Make sure to keep CFG at 1.0 or the video will look weird.
